section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section summarizes the findings of a study that examined the factor structure and psychometric properties of the BAS-2 in Dutch-speaking women in the Netherlands. The study found a one-dimensional factor structure for the Dutch BAS-2 and a significant negative correlation between BAS-2 scores and BMI. Key limitations include the recruitment of only female undergraduates and the lack of generalizability to other populations or Dutch-speaking countries.
